mechanism: Turn-of-month portfolio rebalancing can create recurrent intraday flow pressure and liquidity changes. EURUSD M15 may show a testable short-horizon continuation or fade footprint around the last and first trading days of each month, independent of London breakout/sweep, trend-following, Bollinger squeeze, or signed tick-volume OFI themes.
falsifiable_prediction: A pre-registered EURUSD M15 month-end rebalancing-flow candidate should clear the active Phase 8D research WFA promotion gate after configured costs; otherwise it remains denominator-counted non-survivor evidence.
market_structure_assumption: EURUSD is a liquid FTMO/MT5 symbol, and global portfolio rebalancing flows can appear in major FX rates around turn-of-month windows, but this Phase 8D screen does not assume terminal-history equivalence or executable edge.
instrument_scope: EURUSD M15 FTMO/MT5-relevant research screen using historical EURUSD M15 OHLCV CSV; MT5 instrument equivalence remains unverified.
timeframe_candidate: M15 month-end and first-trading-day rebalancing-flow screen
required_data: EURUSD M15 OHLCV bars with timestamps, source-backed turn-of-month rebalancing mechanism, strategy/config hashes, and later MT5 terminal equivalence before any Phase 8E path.
expected_holding_period: Intraday, typically 1-4 hours via bounded M15 exits and ATR-derived stops/targets.
expected_trade_frequency: Medium but calendar-constrained; no low-frequency exception is registered and the default 200-trade floor applies.
expected_failure_modes: Treasury end-of-month liquidity patterns do not transfer to EURUSD retail CFD bars.
Calendar effects are unstable across regimes or disappear after transaction costs.
The signal becomes a sparse calendar artifact with insufficient trades or poor OOS consistency.
Month-end price pressure resolves too quickly or before the tested UTC window.
invalidation_criteria: Reject as non-survivor if the real WFA fails any active Phase 8D gate on completed OOS windows, trade count, return proxy, OOS Sharpe/profit factor where applicable, concentration, drawdown-to-return, or consistency route.
Reject any Phase 8E, MT5/MQL5, tester parity, or deployment implication unless a separate survivor exists with MT5 equivalence and explicit operator authorization.
Treat any post-result change to symbol, timeframe, costs, parameter ranges, data source, or WFA config as a new denominator-tracked attempt.
implementation_shape: Use walk forward engine/src/strategies/month_end_rebalance_eurusd.py with the canonical month_end_rebalance_eurusd WFA config and deterministic WFA worker.
execution_sensitivity: Sensitive to timezone alignment, definition of last/first trading day, month-end holidays, volume proxy quality, ATR stop/target sizing, spread/slippage assumptions, and terminal-history equivalence.
mt5_ftmo_concerns: EURUSD is present in FTMO terminal evidence, but this screening does not prove MT5 Strategy Tester parity or data equivalence.
prior_related_lessons: Phase 8D screens pre-registered hypotheses and counts weak or failed attempts in the denominator.
The active survivor gate is flexible but compensation requires strong return, Sharpe, profit factor, concentration, drawdown-to-return, and window diagnostics.
Prior failed screens include London breakout/sweep, GBPJPY reversion, XAUUSD trend, BTC BB-width squeeze, BTC volatility-adaptive trend, and EURUSD signed tick-volume OFI.
prior_failed_patterns_checked: Not a London breakout, London sweep, or GBPJPY reversion mutation.
Not XAUUSD trend-following, BTC BB-width squeeze, BTC volatility-adaptive Supertrend, or EURUSD signed tick-volume OFI.
Not a simple RSI strategy and no low-frequency exception is registered.
Uses a new independent New York Fed turn-of-month liquidity/rebalancing source rather than selecting a historical WFA winner.
novelty_reason: First Phase 8D screen of a source-backed turn-of-month rebalancing-flow mechanism on EURUSD M15 using calendar position, intraday momentum, volume regime, and ATR risk controls.
disconfirming_evidence: The source mechanism is from U.S. Treasury markets, not direct EURUSD evidence.
Calendar effects can be fragile and easily overfit if not strictly pre-registered.
Current data is not separately proven equivalent to FTMO terminal EURUSD history.
proposed_experiment_shape: Compile a deterministic Phase 8D research_wfa plan, run the canonical worker on month_end_rebalance_eurusd, emit candidate evidence and summary, then evaluate the shared flexible consistency route without positive labels unless all gates pass.

phase8a_universe_constraints.terminal_symbol_evidence: EURUSD appears in FTMO terminal universe evidence; data equivalence is not verified in this Phase 8D screen.
